SmtLib:
(reset)
(set-logic QF_BV)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(set-option :timeout 5000)
(set-option :rlimit 1)
(declare-fun input_1 () (_ BitVec 2))
(declare-fun input_0 () (_ BitVec 2))
(declare-fun input_2 () (_ BitVec 2))
(declare-fun input_3 () (_ BitVec 2))
(assert (let ((a!1 (ite (= (ite (= input_0 #b00) #b1 #b0) #b1) input_1 #b00)))
(let ((a!2 (ite (= (ite (= input_0 #b01) #b1 #b0) #b1) input_2 a!1)))
(let ((a!3 (ite (= (ite (= input_0 #b10) #b1 #b0) #b1) input_3 a!2)))
  (not (= a!3 a!3))))))

(check-sat)
